name: climb-trainer
description: Climbing training app — plan generator, guided session player, training diary

scripts.dev:api: DATABASE_URL="${CT_TEST_DATABASE_URL:-}" DATABASE_URL_UNPOOLED="" uv run uvicorn server.app:app --port 8000 --reload
scripts.build: npm --prefix web ci && npm --prefix web run build
scripts.check:web: npm --prefix web run format:check && npm --prefix web run lint && npm --prefix web run typecheck && npm --prefix web run build && npm --prefix web run test
scripts.check:server: uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check . && uv run mypy && CORS_ORIGINS=http://localhost:5173 DATABASE_URL="${CT_TEST_DATABASE_URL:-}" DATABASE_URL_UNPOOLED="" uv run pytest -q
scripts.check: npm run check:web && npm run check:server
scripts.codegen:api: uv run python -m server.openapi_schema | node web/scripts/gen-api-types.mjs
